builder.title: Commercial Proposal
builder.subtitle: Structure the proposal with commercial clarity
builder.description: Fill in the context, deliveries, and project agreements in a cleaner reading. The proposal will be created immediately and can be adjusted later, without a separate review stage.
builder.documentTitleHelper: Direct title, fixed currency in BRL, and less noise help maintain a more executive reading.
builder.narrativeDescription: Fill in the context, objectives, and arguments that reinforce why this investment makes sense.
builder.narrativePlaceholder: Present the current moment, the opportunity, and the transformation that this proposal aims to enable.
builder.governanceDescription: Define clear success criteria, what is out of scope, and post-delivery guarantees.
builder.investmentDescription: Organize deliveries with commercial explanation and keep the total investment always visible.
builder.itemsDescription: Each delivery must make clear what is included and what role it plays within the project.
builder.commercialExplanationPlaceholder: Describe what goes into this delivery, how it will be conducted, and what value it generates for the project.
builder.totalInvestmentHelper: Consolidated value of this proposal. Use the items to reinforce the scope and investment reading, not just the price.
builder.connectBonusDescription: Lifetime access to MAGUI Connect included as an exclusive bonus in this proposal.
builder.commercialReadingHelper: Stronger proposals connect delivery, impact, and conduction. When the value appears without context, the perception of investment loses strength.
builder.conditionsDescription: Record how the project will be conducted, what are the next steps, and any observations relevant to the decision.
builder.projectGoalPlaceholder: Ex: structure digital presence, elevate value perception and improve commercial conversation.
builder.expectedImpactPlaceholder: Ex: more clarity in the offer, better brand presentation and more confidence in the commercial process.
builder.differentialsPlaceholder: Ex: centralized conduction, premium language, organized approvals and more professional reading of the project.
builder.paymentConditionsPlaceholder: Ex: 50% on approval/signature and 50% after homologation, with payment via the platform through Stripe.
builder.acceptanceCriteriaDescription: What defines that the project was delivered successfully.
builder.acceptanceCriteriaPlaceholder: Ex: performance above 90, design faithful to the approved, no technical errors.
builder.notIncludedPlaceholder: Ex: photo production, paid traffic management, third-party API costs.
builder.warrantyDescription: Deadlines and conditions for corrections after launch.
builder.warrantyPlaceholder: Ex: 30 days warranty for technical bugs.
builder.nextStepsPlaceholder: Ex: briefing validation, initial material submission and kickoff scheduling.

MaguiConnect.lockedCardManualDescription: You decide what gets highlighted, track clicks and understand where your audience attention is going.
MaguiConnect.lockedBenefitsTitle: Less noise. More focus. More chance to convert.
MaguiConnect.lockedBenefitOneDescription: Instagram, WhatsApp, portfolio, commercial proposal, booking links and any other important destination in one place.
MaguiConnect.lockedBenefitTwoDescription: When people find too many scattered options, they hesitate. When they find a clear path, they act.
MaguiConnect.lockedBenefitThreeDescription: With link analytics, you can see which actions get the most attention and refine your strategy using real behavior.
MaguiConnect.lockedStoryTitle: People who reach you need to understand the next step quickly.
MaguiConnect.lockedStoryDescription: When links are scattered, visitors waste time thinking. With MAGUI Connect, everything stays organized in a clear, direct page that is much easier to consume.
MaguiConnect.lockedFeatureOneTitle: One page for bio, portfolio and contact
MaguiConnect.lockedFeatureOneDescription: Everything that matters in one place, with clear visual hierarchy to guide attention.
MaguiConnect.lockedFeatureTwoDescription: You choose what deserves more visibility, leading people to the right action at the right moment.
MaguiConnect.lockedFeatureThreeTitle: A visual aligned with your brand
MaguiConnect.lockedFeatureThreeDescription: Name, photo, banner, description, colors and structure designed to feel professional and coherent.
MaguiConnect.lockedFeatureFourDescription: Analytics help you understand which links receive more clicks and where attention is going.

MaguiConnect.lockedHowStepTwoDescription: After your request, we reach out with the invoice for payment.

MaguiConnect.lockedValuePointOne: A more professional way to present yourself.
MaguiConnect.lockedValuePointTwo: More focus on the action that matters most.
MaguiConnect.lockedValuePointThree: Less friction and less distraction for the visitor.
MaguiConnect.lockedValuePointFour: Better insight to decide what should be highlighted.
MaguiConnect.lockedValuePointFive: More control over the journey of the people reaching you.

overview.economyDescription: Too many options look like freedom, but usually increase hesitation. A good page doesn't show everything: it guides the eye to what has the most value.
overview.topAnchorsDescription: The first highlight becomes a mental reference. Use this position to place the action you most want to receive.
overview.clickDenouncesInterestDescription: Behavior is worth more than opinion. If a link receives attention, it's saying something about your audience's intent.
overview.excessStealsConversionDescription: Each weak option competes against the strong option. Removing noise can be more efficient than adding new paths.
overview.realReadingHeadline: Your numbers show where attention exists.
overview.realReadingDescription: Use these signals to decide what goes up, what goes down, and what no longer deserves to compete for space with the main action.
overview.clickHierarchyHeadline: Make the right path seem obvious.
overview.ruleOneDescription: Contact, purchase, quote, or portfolio. When there's a visual priority, the visitor understands faster what to do.
overview.ruleTwoDescription: Secondary links should complement the journey, not compete with the main goal of the page.
overview.ruleThreeDescription: Clicks show which calls attract attention. Use this to refine the page without depending on guesswork.
